scope: Recorded model attribution in actual AI review, course information, syllabus, course study player and portable exports
limitations: Configured-agent attribution is retained from the source/result generation record; it is not a live API receipt or evidence of identical API outputs.
Previously saved imports without authoring metadata remain explicitly unattributed; new imports retain the record.
Rendered learner views use JSDOM with native shells and progress persistence stubbed, after real HTTP publication and learner re-login.
No live SSO, paid provider call, deployment, new browser visual check or institution acceptance.
